title: 2026 waste voluntary-MRV monitoring and annual-report QA controls

sources.title: Voluntary MRV period for EfW and waste incineration
UK ETS technical guidance and tools

facts.source_fact: Each participating operator needs a voluntary monitoring plan.
The monitoring plan serves as a manual for operator tasks during the voluntary period.
Operators monitor emissions in line with the voluntary monitoring plan.
Operators submit emissions to regulators through an annual emissions report.
Operators are encouraged to have the annual emissions report verified.
facts.expected_handling: Keep encouragement distinct from mandatory verification.

facts.source_fact: The technical collection includes VMRVP01 guidance for waste installations in the voluntary MRV period.
VMRVP01 was revised on 5 May 2026 to include preliminary and biomass-fraction emission factors in its annex.
Technical guidance can change and should be version-checked before reuse.
Voluntary-period reporting is preparatory and does not itself establish future surrender liability.
Document-level monitoring/reporting evidence is not a parcel-level measured value.
